tagline: Rebuild failing discs through nutrition + movement — without surgery.
thesis: Pain relief removes the symptom. The environment that caused the disc to fail is still there. Fix the environment.
voice: calm authority, plain language, slightly contrarian, no hype, no emoji walls, short sentences, concrete anatomy, one idea per slide

form.interior: light #f4f6f8 page, teal accents, rounded cards, pill tags, left-border flag callouts

compliance: never claim cure/reverse/replace surgery — use 'recovery environment', 'support healing'
cauda equina / red-flag symptoms must say 'see a doctor immediately'
testimonials real, with permission, framed as individual results
assessment not diagnosis; coach/nutritionist, not physician
